Please soften the wording, put the invoice number and the amount at the top, keep the payment link, and keep the German and Italian versions in step with the English one. The finance team will review the new wording, so keep the old text available somewhere in case they prefer it. Thanks, and let me know if anything here conflicts with how the scheduler works.
